description: Uptime / API health check: is a URL up, HTTP status, response time, redirect chain, headers and security headers (edge), plus the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry date, days remaining, SAN, verification errors). A down target is a valid answer. Paid ($0.0002, x402).

check_ssl.description: Also inspect the TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, verification)

follow_redirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects to the final URL

method.description: HTTP method used for the check
